title: Design and Characterization of Neutral Linker-Based Bis-Intercalator via Computer Simulations: Balancing DNA Binding and Cellular Uptake.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和MM-PBSA等方法设计并表征了中性连接子的双嵌入剂与DNA的结合及细胞摄取，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系（此处为小分子-DNA），方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: Bis-intercalators refer to a class of chemical compounds known for their unique ability to simultaneously intercalate, or insert, into DNA at two distinct sites. These molecules typically feature two intercalating moieties connected by a linker, allowing them to engage with DNA base pairs at multiple locations. The bis-intercalation phenomenon plays a significant role in altering the DNA structure, affecting its stability, and potentially influencing various cellular processes. These compounds have gained considerable attention in medicinal chemistry and biochemistry due to their potential applications in cancer therapy, where they may interfere with DNA replication and transcription, leading to anticancer effects. Traditionally, these molecules often possess a high positive charge to enhance their affinity for the negatively charged DNA. However, due to a high positive charge, their cellular uptake is compromised, along with their enhanced potential off-target effects. In this study, we utilized bis-intercalator TOTO and replaced the charged linker segment (propane-1,3-diammonium) with a neutral peroxodisulphuric acid linker. Using molecular modeling and computer simulations (500 ns, 3 replicas), we investigated the potential of the designed molecule as a bis-intercalator and compared the properties with the control bis-intercalator bound to DNA. We observed that the designed bis-intercalator exhibited improved DNA binding (as assessed through MM-PBSA and Delphi methods) and membrane translocation permeability. With an overall reduced charge, significantly less off-target binding of the designed molecule is also anticipated. Consequently, bis-intercalators based on peroxodisulphuric linkers can potentially target DNA effectively, and their role in the future design of bis-intercalators is foreseen.
abstract_zh: 双嵌入剂是指一类化学化合物，以其独特的能力同时嵌入或插入DNA的两个不同位点而闻名。这些分子通常具有两个嵌入部分，通过连接子相连，使其能够在多个位置与DNA碱基对相互作用。双嵌入现象在改变DNA结构、影响其稳定性以及可能影响多种细胞过程方面发挥着重要作用。这些化合物因其在癌症治疗中的潜在应用而受到药物化学和生物化学领域的广泛关注，它们可能干扰DNA复制和转录，从而产生抗癌效果。传统上，这些分子通常带有高正电荷以增强其对带负电DNA的亲和力。然而，由于高正电荷，其细胞摄取能力受损，同时潜在脱靶效应增加。在本研究中，我们利用双嵌入剂TOTO，并将带电荷的连接子段（丙烷-1,3-二铵）替换为中性过氧二硫酸连接子。通过分子建模和计算机模拟（500 ns，3个重复），我们研究了设计分子作为双嵌入剂的潜力，并将其性质与结合DNA的对照双嵌入剂进行了比较。我们观察到，设计双嵌入剂表现出改善的DNA结合能力（通过MM-PBSA和Delphi方法评估）和膜转位通透性。由于整体电荷减少，预计设计分子的脱靶结合也显著减少。因此，基于过氧二硫酸连接子的双嵌入剂可能有效靶向DNA，并预见其在未来双嵌入剂设计中的作用。
